author: DottieL
html: I absolutely love this pattern. The pig is adorable. What is your policy on selling them once their made? I would of course link back to your pattern - and no worries at all if you would prefer not to do that.

author: Vira
html:
Hi! Thank you for your words about the piglet!!
Of course, you can sell the finished toys, it is absolutely okay!
